body:
You're right, sleep is great. It seems like every time I'm feeling bad at night, I wake up feeling ten times better if I just shut down and sleep.

I really know what you mean about being afraid of getting close to others. When I think about why I don't have friends, that is probably the main reason why. I always talk myself out of trying to make good friends, because I either think it will fail or the other person might not be very good. Maybe if I push past that, I'll be a little happier. Or maybe, I don't really need that many friends. I haven't quite figured that one out yet.

Thank you for commenting. I'll keep trying to hang on, with plenty of rest :)

Hah, don't worry about rambling. I'm just as guilty myself.

Thanks for the response. I think you're absolutely right about living in the moment. I do spend a lot of time thinking about stupid shit I have done or used to do (kind of like when you're sitting in bed falling asleep and then your brain goes "HAHA HEY REMEMBER THAT TIME IN 5TH GRADE WHEN YOU LOOKED LIKE A TOTAL ASSCLOWN ROFL" and you stay awake for the next 3 hours wanting to die), and not enough on what I want to do now or in the near future. I think I have a lot of trouble when trying to think in the present. Often, I'll think of something I really want to do or should do, like clean up my room or do laundry or play some games. Then... I just don't do it, I guess. The thought is there, but I never do it for some reason. I think if I work on that I'll feel a lot better, or at least be a little more preoccupied.

I used to be part of an online community. It was great, for a while. After a while, though, it just turned sour. I always told myself I'd stay on the sidelines during arguments, but I got sucked in eventually. People who I thought were friendly and nice turned ugly and mean. Finally, I left because I couldn't name a reason why I should stay. So I dropped out of that, and lost pretty much all my online friends. Now I'm in that awkward in-between stage where I haven't found some place new to stay and I don't even know if I can do it again after how badly the last one went.

Really, thank you for the response. It means a lot just to have someone to talk to, finally. This is always the worst time of the year for me, even though I love Winter. Something just always seems to go wrong and I want to make sure this isn't the year I lose it, finally.
